{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0) to account for bearish bias.",
    "Reduce forecast volatility in early stages of downward trends (e.g., after 3-5 consecutive negative sentiment days).",
    "Apply mean reversion correction: if forecast is > 10% above recent 5-day average, reduce by 5-10%.",
    "Avoid over-optimism after sharp price spikes: cap forecast at 10% below peak observed in last 7 days.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment is positive but price is trending lower (e.g., sentiment > 0.5 but price declining).",
    "For long-term forecasts (30d), reduce forecast by 2-5% if sentiment is neutral or negative over last 5 days.",
    "If sentiment is positive and price is falling, apply a ‘rebound lag’ correction: delay upward adjustment by 1-2 days."
  ]
}
